def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    idx = pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id")

    # --- Базовая таблица позиций заказов, совершённых строго до seed_time ---
    df = order_items.merge(
        orders[["order_id", "order_purchase_timestamp",
                "order_delivered_customer_date", "order_estimated_delivery_date"]],
        on="order_id", how="left"
    )
    df = df[df["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time]

    # --- Платежи: только те, что известны к seed_time (по ts) ---
    pay = payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time]
    payments_agg = pay.groupby("order_id").agg(
        payment_sum=("payment_value", "sum"),
        payment_installments_mean=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        payment_type_nunique=("payment_type", "nunique"),
    ).reset_index()

    # --- Отзывы: только те, что уже созданы к seed_time ---
    rev = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time]
    reviews_agg = rev.groupby("order_id").agg(
        review_score_mean=("review_score", "mean"),
        review_count=("review_id", "count"),
    ).reset_index()

    df = df.merge(payments_agg, on="order_id", how="left")
    df = df.merge(reviews_agg, on="order_id", how="left")

    df = df[df["product_id"].isin(entity_ids)].copy()

    def empty_block(cols):
        return pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=idx, columns=cols)

    def window_features(data, window_days):
        suffix = "all" if window_days is None else f"{window_days}d"
        cols = [f"count_{suffix}", f"sum_price_{suffix}", f"avg_price_{suffix}",
                f"sum_freight_{suffix}", f"avg_freight_{suffix}",
                f"sum_payment_{suffix}", f"avg_payment_{suffix}",
                f"avg_installments_{suffix}", f"avg_review_score_{suffix}",
                f"pos_review_ratio_{suffix}"]
        if data.empty:
            return empty_block(cols)
        if window_days is None:
            sub = data
        else:
            sub = data[data["order_purchase_timestamp"] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=window_days)]
        if sub.empty:
            return empty_block(cols)
        g = sub.groupby("product_id").agg(
            count=("order_id", "nunique"),
            sum_price=("price", "sum"),
            avg_price=("price", "mean"),
            sum_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
            avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
            sum_payment=("payment_sum", "sum"),
            avg_payment=("payment_sum", "mean"),
            avg_installments=("payment_installments_mean", "mean"),
            avg_review_score=("review_score_mean", "mean"),
            pos_review_ratio=("review_score_mean",
                              lambda x: float((x >= 4).mean())),
        )
        g.columns = cols
        return g.reindex(idx).fillna(0.0)

    features = pd.concat(
        [window_features(df, w) for w in [7, 30, 90, None]],
        axis=1
    )

    # --- Тренд: продажи 30-60 дней назад против последних 30 дней ---
    if df.empty:
        prev_block = empty_block(["count_prev_30d", "sum_price_prev_30d"])
    else:
        sub_prev = df[(df["order_purchase_timestamp"] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=60)) &
                      (df["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30))]
        if sub_prev.empty:
            prev_block = empty_block(["count_prev_30d", "sum_price_prev_30d"])
        else:
            g = sub_prev.groupby("product_id").agg(
                count_prev_30d=("order_id", "nunique"),
                sum_price_prev_30d=("price", "sum"),
            )
            prev_block = g.reindex(idx).fillna(0.0)
    features = pd.concat([features, prev_block], axis=1)
    features["count_trend_30d"] = features["count_30d"] - features["count_prev_30d"]
    features["sum_price_trend_30d"] = features["sum_price_30d"] - features["sum_price_prev_30d"]

    # --- Возраст и давность последней продажи ---
    if df.empty:
        features["age_days"] = 0.0
        features["recency_days"] = 9999.0
        features["days_since_last_review"] = 9999.0
        features["review_count_all"] = 0.0

        features["recency_days"] = ((seed_time - last_sale).dt.days).reindex(idx).fillna(9999.0)

        # Отзывы по товару (уже отфильтрованы по дате создания)
        rev_prod = df[df["review_count"].notna()]
        if rev_prod.empty:
            features["days_since_last_review"] = 9999.0
            features["review_count_all"] = 0.0
        else:
            last_rev = rev_prod.groupby("product_id")["review_creation_date_x"].max() \

            features["review_count_all"] = rev_prod.groupby("product_id")["review_count"].sum().reindex(idx).fillna(0.0)
            # давность последнего отзыва оценим через последний заказ с отзывом
            last_rev_order = rev_prod.groupby("product_id")["order_purchase_timestamp"].max()
            features["days_since_last_review"] = ((seed_time - last_rev_order).dt.days).reindex(idx).fillna(9999.0)

        # Доставка: только если дата доставки уже известна и в прошлом
        deliv = df[df["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna() &

        if deliv.empty:
            features["avg_delivery_delay"] = 0.0
            features["late_delivery_ratio"] = 0.0
        else:
            deliv["delay"] = (deliv["order_delivered_customer_date"] -
                              deliv["order_estimated_delivery_date"]).dt.days
            g = deliv.groupby("product_id").agg(
                avg_delivery_delay=("delay", "mean"),
                late_delivery_ratio=("delay", lambda x: float((x > 0).mean())),
            )
            features = features.join(g.reindex(idx).fillna(0.0))
            features[["avg_delivery_delay", "late_delivery_ratio"]] = \
                features[["avg_delivery_delay", "late_delivery_ratio"]].fillna(0.0)

        # Прочие агрегаты за всё время
        g = df.groupby("product_id").agg(
            price_std_all=("price", "std"),
            n_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
            avg_installments_all=("payment_installments_mean", "mean"),
            payment_type_nunique_all=("payment_type_nunique", "max"),
        )
        features = features.join(g.reindex(idx))
        features["price_std_all"] = features["price_std_all"].fillna(0.0)
        features["n_sellers"] = features["n_sellers"].fillna(0.0)
        features["avg_installments_all"] = features["avg_installments_all"].fillna(0.0)
        features["payment_type_nunique_all"] = features["payment_type_nunique_all"].fillna(0.0)

        # Число активных месяцев с продажами
        months = df.assign(m=df["order_purchase_timestamp"].dt.to_period("M")) \
                   .groupby("product_id")["m"].nunique()
        features["sales_active_months"] = months.reindex(idx).fillna(0.0)

    features = features.fillna(0.0)
    features = features.reindex(entity_ids)
    features = features.astype(float)
    return features
